question: Was stellen die blauen Balken im unteren Bereich der Grafik dar?
question_english: What do the blue bars in the lower area of the chart represent?
model_answer: The blue bars at the bottom of the graph represent the trade balance (in Mrd. US-Dollar). They show the difference between exports (left scale, blue line) and imports (left scale, dark blue line) over time. Positive values indicate a trade surplus, while negative values indicate a trade deficit.
